name: Event Presentation
description: Presentation deck for conferences, webinars, and live events with audience engagement focus.
prompt_template:
Generate an event presentation for {house_name} using the messaging framework below.

GROUNDING CONTEXT:
{context}

Generate exactly 6 slides as a JSON array. Each slide must have:
- "layout": one of ["title", "hook", "content", "timeline", "quote", "closing"]
- "heading": slide heading (max 8 words)
- "content": array of strings (bullet points or paragraphs)
- "notes": speaker notes (2-3 sentences — include audience engagement tips)
- "image_prompt": optional visual description

Slide structure:
1. Title Slide — event name: {event_name}, company, tagline
2. Opening Hook — surprising stat or question from the framework
3. Market Context — trends and positioning context
4. Key Insights — 3 insights from key messages and personas
5. Solution Highlight — differentiation + 1 key benefit
6. Key Takeaways + Q&A — 3 takeaways + call to action

Output ONLY valid JSON array. No markdown fences.
